scripts.compact: npm run compact:dice && npm run compact:turn && npm run compact:scoring && npm run compact:takeTurn
scripts.compact:fast: compact compile --skip-zk src/dice.compact src/managed/dice && compact compile --skip-zk src/turn.compact src/managed/turn && compact compile --skip-zk src/scoring.compact src/managed/scoring && compact compile --skip-zk src/takeTurn.compact src/managed/takeTurn
scripts.//build:skip-zk: .github/workflows/ci.yml calls `npm run build:skip-zk -w contract --if-present`, and until now no such script existed -- so `--if-present` silently skipped it, src/managed was never generated in CI, and `npm test` could not have been passing there. Aliased to compact:fast rather than renaming it, so the CI workflow needs no change.
scripts.format:compact: compact format src/dice-core.compact src/dice.compact src/turn.compact src/scoring-core.compact src/scoring.compact src/takeTurn.compact
scripts.measure: scripts/measure-build.sh build/measure && node scripts/zkir-stats.mjs build/measure/dice-zk build/measure/turn-zk build/measure/scoring-zk build/measure/takeTurn-zk
scripts.zkir-stats: node scripts/zkir-stats.mjs src/managed/dice src/managed/turn src/managed/scoring src/managed/takeTurn
scripts.//test: --experimental-transform-types, not the default strip-only mode: the scoring cross-check imports api/src/rules.ts, whose `export enum Category` strip-only refuses (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX -- an enum has runtime behaviour that cannot be erased). See docs/scoring-circuit.md.
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf src/managed dist/managed
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
